ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 75% high-intensity white/light-grey pixels across the central lobes and 25% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels concentrated at the peduncle junction and trailing margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity contiguous field spanning the majority of both lobes. Central low-intensity wedge-shaped blob at the peduncle connection. Thin low-intensity marginal bands along the trailing edges. Small, discrete dark circular spots located in the upper-right and mid-left quadrants.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate pixel angle of 38 degrees and a vertical depth roughly 15% of the total vertical extent of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 2-10 pixels forming a jagged continuous boundary along the entire trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curvature along the posterior edges of both lobes, terminating in sharp, slightly anteriorly-hooked tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of several circular high-contrast dark pixel clusters; one large prominent mark on the upper right lobe and a cluster of smaller spots on the mid-left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct series of parallel and unaligned linear dark streaks (rake marks) oriented diagonally across the mid-section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible linear rake marks on the left lobe and specific circular scarring/pigmentation marks on the distal right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly unique dark 'S'-shaped pigmentation pattern contained within a circular perimeter on the upper right quadrant of the fluke.
